xmldoc.short_description: Internal function to convert xml document files to html.

syntax.syntax_item: status = xmldocbuild(source_dirs, destination_dir, main_title, export_format, overwrite)
[status, msg, warnings] = xmldocbuild(source_dirs, destination_dir, main_title, export_format, overwrite, index_dirs)

param_input_item.param_description: a cell of string: list of xml filenames.
a string: title of main index.
a logical: force overwrite if file destination already exists
a cell of string (optional): XML help roots of the other modules whose pages may be linked, used to resolve <link linkend="${module}name">.

param_output_item.param_description: a logical: files generated or not.
a string: error message, empty on success.
a cell of string: links that could not be resolved. Without this output, each one is raised as a warning.

description.p: xmldocbuild convert xml document files to html.

Links (<link linkend="...">) are resolved from the keyword index of source_dirs and index_dirs: the target may be a keyword, an alias or a page path relative to the module root, optionally prefixed by ${module} or {module}. A resolved link points to the real page, even when it lives in a chapter sub-directory or when its file name differs from its keyword. An unresolved link keeps the legacy path "<module>/<name>" and is reported.

history_item.history_description: index_dirs input and warnings output: links resolved from the keyword index.
